Report confidence intervals and method details alongside existing MAE/RMSE, directional, quantile, coverage, and provenance views. Use SPA or other family-wise inference only for a defined family of forecast comparisons; reserve DSR/PBO/Sharpe and costs for a later strategy-level study. Keep historical replay and post-release results distinct, disclose possible pretraining overlap, and do not tune the frozen protocol after looking at results. Preserve existing ClickHouse snapshot and offline report contracts; keep changes on feat/david-clickhouse-timesfm-eval and do not modify backtest_guide.md or Ethan-owned work.
acceptance_criteria: A versioned analysis protocol defines paired per-origin MAE differences, stationary-bootstrap dependence treatment, block length, random seed, and the complete Holm-adjusted comparison family. Because the frozen forecasts were inspected before adding inference, every inferential result and viewer is explicitly labeled exploratory/post-hoc, not preregistered or confirmatory. Integrity controls catch timestamp alignment, duplicate/missing bars, target leakage, nonfinite/invalid forecasts, and mispaired targets; deterministic known-answer fixtures verify scoring and uncertainty. Confidence intervals and adjusted tests reproduce from pinned forecasts without ClickHouse or model weights. The offline report shows provenance, counts, paired effects/intervals, no trading-edge claim, pretraining caveats, and explicitly marks cumulative freshness outcomes unavailable when sparse leads prevent reconstruction. Independent review records remaining limitations and reruns preserve artifact identities.

Inferential family spans all saved MAE leads/horizons; sparse freshness artifacts do not support cumulative 6h/24h scores. Review bundle must preserve frozen forecasts and report the limitation.
Planning references retained: Salesforce GIFT-Eval (https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.10393; https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/gift-eval), Google TimesFM 3 public evaluation post (https://research.google/blog/timesfm-3-a-zero-shot-foundation-model-for-multivariate-forecasting/), Nixtla rolling-origin CV (https://nixtla.github.io/nixtlar/articles/cross-validation.html), Hansen SPA (https://doi.org/10.1002/jae.800), and Bailey et al. The analysis supplement applies Holm to a fixed forecast-comparison family; SPA/DSR/PBO/Sharpe are not used as raw forecasting metrics.
